title: trace-event
description: One line of a PerfStack trace file (JSONL; one file = one rep of one arm). Times are host-epoch ms, except events with `src`, which are shifted by that source's sync offset. Written by Perf.swift (native), perf.ts (RN) and the perf-climb harness (meta). docs/orbit/perf/PERFSTACK.md section 4.

k.description: meta | span begin | span end | mark | main-runloop busy stretch | count | fixture | clock sync sample

t.description: ms; absent only on harness meta

id.description: b/e: span id, unique per trace

n.description: b: span name; m: mark (`<screen>:<milestone>`, milestone in tap|first_frame|data_ready|interactive); c/f: counter or fixture name

ph.description: b: phase bucket (navigation, data, render, layout, ...); inherited from the parent when absent

th.description: b/busy: thread, `main` or `bg:<qos>`; inherited when absent

t0.description: sync: source clock before the bridge call

impl.description: meta: the arm, e.g. legacy | next | rn | native
